messages:
maria.su: Heads-up: AcmeCorp (paid) reporting p99 generation times ~6-8s and intermittent timeouts. Seen ~450 waitlist in us-east-1 pool over last 3m. Their request ids: r-71a2f, r-71a2g. Anyone oncall? :warning:

sam.kim: I'm on it. Which model/pool and any recent config/deploys?

maria.su: us-east-1 shared-hosted, model=gpt-micro-v2. We pushed a runtime kernel tweak ~20m ago (eng-runtime). p95 looks okay but p99 jumped. Key metrics: admission_waitlist up, worker_cpu at 95% on a subset, p99 latency spike. Logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T09:12:11Z pool=us-east-1 model=gpt-micro-v2 tid=r-71a2f admission_waitlist=312 active_workers=48 batch_size=64 latency_p99=6200ms
2026-03-15T09:12:42Z pool=us-east-1 model=gpt-micro-v2 tid=r-71a2g admission_waitlist=428 active_workers=50 batch_size=82 latency_p99=7500ms
```

eng-oncall-bot: alert: admission_waitlist > 300 for 7m (us-east-1). Top tenant: acme-corp (40% of inflight).

patrick: That batch_size jump (64 -> 82) smells like the continuous-batching kernel change. Short prompts can get coalesced into big batches and amplify tail latency. Can we revert batching changes or lower max_batch?

sam.kim: Quick mitigations I can roll now: 1) enable fast-fail for non-priority endpoints 2) apply tenant throttling for acme-corp 3) temporarily raise pool max_concurrency (80->120) to reduce waitlist. I'll stage the config change to 10% then roll.

sam.kim: Pushing config change: `rbctl apply --env=prod --pool=us-east-1 --set max_concurrency=120,max_batch_size=48,fast_fail=true`

deploy-bot: rollout started: hosted-configs/us-east-1 (sam.kim). 10% -> 100% in 2m.

patrick: Also start warmup on idle workers to prime KV caches: `scripts/warmup_pool.sh us-east-1 20` — primes 20 workers with short prompts.

aaron: Added emergency tenant rate limit: tenant=acme-corp limit=60rpm. Monitoring.

maria.su: Warmup started. Notified Acme support contact (Bryan) that we're applying mitigations and may throttle heavy bursts. Asked for repro steps if they can consistently hit it.

sam.kim: Watching metrics: admission_waitlist dropping to ~90, p99 trending down to ~2.2s — still above SLA but improving. If not stable in 10m we'll flip fallback model variant: gpt-micro-v2-quant which has lower per-token latency.

patrick: Filing hypothesis ticket: "kernel batching change increased batch formation for short prompts -> tail latency". Will capture traces and sample payloads.

maria.su: Customer updated: some requests still time out but error rate decreased by 60%. They accepted temporary throttling for bursts. I'll keep them posted every 15m. :thumbsup:

sam.kim: If p99 normalizes, we'll keep throttles and reduced batch size for 1h then revert to monitor. Also want to schedule a rollback of the kernel tweak if traces confirm.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: hosted-configs/us-east-1 (sam.kim) -> 100%

eng-oncall-bot: update: admission_waitlist now 42, p99=2100ms, p95=420ms.

maria.su: Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring and will open an escalation ticket for eng-runtime for a deeper root-cause. Please post any further mitigations here.

sam.kim: Thanks — will keep an eye. If anything regresses, @patrick please be ready to revert the kernel tweak.

patrick: Roger. Adding traces to the ticket and will run controlled AB test tomorrow.

maria.su: Closing loop with customer in 30m after we confirm stability. :white_check_mark:
